top_signal.title: How should I deal with this situation? (Small business employee rant)
top_signal.summary: I’m 17 in online school and I’m working two jobs to save up for college right now. One of them is at a local coffee shop, I’ll probably be quitting this job next spring or mid summer at the latest but I’m considering doing it early because of a lot of different reasons right now. I’m just kind of looking for guidance/advice on how I should go about this?   my first small issue with the owner was that she’s very unprofessional, she’s very unorganized but I’m really bothered by the way she texts. she texts like a middle schooler or something, she types with like “r u working tom” instead of “Are you working tomorrow?” but she does this with everything   there was a time a few weeks ago where she was asking for my availability and sent me a screenshot from months ago when I told her what days I was free to start my training and she said “im confused is this still ur availabile?” She also was in total disbelief when I needed to change my hours because school started back, she asked me the same question three times and then gave me a random phone call where she acted like I was scamming her out of an employee or something because I can’t work as much now   along with the unprofessional texting she texts constantly and has cameras on us at all times, she’ll check them on her phone and text us stuff like “ur sitting for ten minutes u shld clean 🤗” keep in mind there’s not much cleaning we can do after we’ve wiped and reset the coffee prep station, mopping and running clean settings
